notes:
Stage: moved from hosted API evaluation -> Dedicated interest after latency/cost tradeoff review.
Shorthand and call snippets below.
- 2025-11-08: initial inbound from product team (use case: intelligent in-app product assistant + doc search). AE Jordan assigned.
- 2025-12-02: quick demo of Hosted API; engineering liked streaming + embeddings. Trial keys issued.
- 2026-01-12: Hosted POC (2 weeks) completed: embeddings index + chat; measured 90th pct latency ~180ms on short prompts using hosted. Cost baseline established (approx $0.04 per 1k tokens equivalent for embeddings + gen).
- 2026-01-25: team asks options for Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC egress control. Raised pricing/commitment question (reserved capacity vs burst).
- 2026-02-10: security questionnaire submitted (30+ Qs). Requested: SOC2 report, SSO/SAML via Okta, KMS integration, audit log retention 12 months, data residency controls (US only).
- 2026-02-12: SE session (Priya) ran through architecture constraints: must support private VPC peering, egress allowlist, and no outbound internet from inference nodes.
- 2026-02-15: POC plan agreed: 2-week Dedicated POC in staging with A10G-equivalent nodes, sample traffic 500 QPS for reranking & chat, target latency 150-250ms P95 for short-chat templates.
- 2026-02-18: legal sent draft SOW questions (term length, liability, IP). Pricing conversation started — negotiating 12-month commit vs 6-month pilot.
- 2026-02-20: Security review prep: customer asked for SOC2 Type II report, list of subservice orgs, summary of audit logging retention policies, and KMS key flow doc.
Notes from prospects: "We can't have model inputs stored more than 30 days in logs. Audit log retention policy must be configurable per-customer." Quote from Head of Security: "Need proof we can run in our VPC w/ no egress and integration with Okta SAML for SSO. Also want per-request audit IDs and 1 year immutable audit archive."
POC acceptance criteria (customer side): Dedicated deployment in VPC with peering; SAML SSO + Okta integration; KMS-managed keys; audit logs forwarded to their Splunk instance; retention controls configurable to 30/90/365 days; P95 latency <= 250ms under target QPS; cost projection within forecast range.
POC risks: network egress constraints may require extra infra work; SOC2 evidence delivery timing (current SOC2 in progress, expected Q2 2026) may slow procurement.
Other notes: competitive push from OpenAI managed endpoints + internal infra team evaluating bringing models in-house. Price sensitivity: wants line of sight to per-token/unit economics across mixed embedding + generation workload.

sales_playbook_notes:
Mid-market product org with strong security control checklist. Successful path: start with Hosted to prove UX -> move to Dedicated with VPC for security signoff -> close on 12-month reserved with option to scale. Emphasize observable unit economics (token-level cost breakdown) and rollback/fallback policies. Offer security-runbook + dedicated SE support for POC.
Tactical: prioritize delivering SOC2 summary and a clear KMS integration diagram to unblock security review.
